subject.title: feat: prove Blocks, Commerce, and Inventory together

question: Should this starter support the exact pre-release source aliases and disposable proof adapter as a bounded pilot, or remain documentation/scaffolding until installable dependencies exist?
rationale: The implementation deliberately creates a starter-level dependency and support contract that source validation cannot decide.

options.title: Sponsor the bounded pilot
options.body: Accept the exact pins and proof-only adapter with their temporary, non-production boundaries documented as the starter's current pilot contract.

options.title: Narrow to scaffolding
options.body: Retain documentation and feature structure but defer live Commerce and Inventory wiring until installable releases establish a supported dependency path.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the bounded pilot
recommendation.body: Accept the exact pins and proof-only adapter with their temporary, non-production boundaries documented as the starter's current pilot contract.

likelyOwner.reason: The repository owner defines the starter's product and release boundary.
